narrative: As the US stock market rises to a record high, buoyed by declining oil prices and reduced inflation concerns, investor sentiment is shifting. A potential probe by the FTC into Epic Systems is casting a shadow, while ALNY and VSTM stocks face investigation and downgrades. Conversely, Praj Industries and China's AI chip stocks experience a surge, and Transcontinental Realty Investors sees an upgrade, signaling a mix of growth opportunities and potential headwinds.
